articles.title: Wall Street is starting to notice one of crypto’s smartest AI bets
articles.snippet: A growing spotlight on Nof1’s Alpha Arena suggests SUI Group and Karatage may have gotten early to one of the most important experiments in finance: teaching AI how to trade in real markets.

articles.title: Cardano whales now hold 67% of ADA supply in highest share since 2020
articles.snippet: Wallets holding at least one million ADA now control 25.09 billion tokens, the highest share since July 2020, even as Cardano's TVL has bled to $137 million from a December 2024 peak of $686 million, per Santiment and DefiLlama data.

articles.title: Bitcoin Owner Claims Claude AI Cracked Lost Wallet Password, Netting $400K in BTC
articles.snippet: A viral thread on X drew millions of views as a user claimed Claude AI helped recover a lost Bitcoin wallet.
